text_block_list.text:
One evening, I find Симболи Рудольф gazing
out onto the track with a
deeply moved
expression on her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you. Good timing. Do you have a
moment?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it's nothing serious. I wanted
to share this view with you,
that's all.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Do you see Нарита Брайан over there? She's
in the student council with
me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The other day, she told me she'd dethrone
me—that no crown is so
secure that it can't
be knocked off one's head.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's as she says. With each passing day, she
grows stronger and faster.
She runs
doggedly toward her prize, never looking
back.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Each student in this academy invests the
entirety of their spirit into
running ever
faster toward their goal.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And seeing that motivates me in turn. As
the Академия Тайсен student
council
president, and as someone who wishes for
their happiness.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
There is yet more I must achieve for their
sakes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
All the more reason you can't afford to be
dethroned right now.

text_block_list.text: Precisely.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I am to stand above my peers and guide
them, I must prove myself
worthy of such a
position.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The path before us is clear. However,
neither of us can achieve such a
Herculean
feat alone. We must work in lockstep—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Eek!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Hm? What was that?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Look—over there! A pair of students just
collapsed! Quickly, follow
me!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Are you all right?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Huh?! P-President Rudolf?!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Don't force yourself to move. You just
took a fall, didn't you? Could
one of you
explain what happened?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: U-um, well, actually...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: No, wait! I'm sorry! It's my fault!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We were just... well, we were tickling each
other, and we lost our
balance, that's all...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
W-we're sorry! We didn't mean to take up
your time! Don't worry
about us, we'll be
fine!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: It's fine, I didn't mean to cause any—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: We're so sorryyyyy!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
The girls dash off as fast as their legs can
carry them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I suppose I should be glad that neither
was hurt.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That said, I jumped to a hasty conclusion
and ended up frightening
those poor girls.
I still have much to learn... How
embarrassing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I do want to close the gap between the
other students and myself,
but it's
certainly not going to happen anytime
soon.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I truly appreciate it. I'm
looking forward to your guidance
from
here on out.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
